_doc: Buccaneer line (spec #412, ticket B2 #414). The fourth Brawler job (Pirate 500 -> Brawler 510 -> Marauder 511 -> Buccaneer 512), the first to carry a class's own AP row and HP growth beside its meter. A class spec adds jobs/<line>.json, skills/<line>.json (empty skeleton until its tickets define skills), automatically discovered by DataRepo.lines() (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4): nothing shared is edited. Skill keys stay inert until their definitions exist: skills/pirate.json defines the five ported knuckle skills and Dash until B4/B5 move them; the rest are undefined and never offered. playable stays false until B11 flips it; default_job stays 212.

512._starting_skill: tier C: spec #412 (BU-14): the Flash Fist, slot 1; defined by skills/pirate.json until B4 ports it to skills/buccaneer.json.
512._mobility_skill: tier C: spec #412 (BU-1): Dash (WZ 5001005) is Buccaneer's manual mobility skill on the skill key, outside both slot tracks; defined by skills/pirate.json on slot mobility (B5 #417; Corsair reuses it).
512._skill_pool: tier C: spec #412 (BU-1, BU-4): eleven entries for the Brawler's skills. Shockwave is a sub-skill of Transformation, Demolition and Snatch of Super Transformation, and Energy Blast is dropped (BU-4), so none of them is a pool entry.
512._weapon_families: tier C: spec #412 (BU-20): the knuckles (WeaponInfo.family 148, 1482xxx); guns, swords, axes, bows, wands and claws never drop for a Buccaneer. Armour and shields drop by the class bit (Pirate for armour, Warrior for shields, which a Buccaneer does not admit).
512._creation_weapon: tier A: the Steel Knuckler (Item.wz 1482000, reqJob 16 = the Pirate bit; its level requirement is gone with #292). Already in the Pirate manifest fragment.
512._meter: tier C: spec #412 (BU-5): Energy Charge, max 10, one energy per landed cast of a non-finisher pool skill, +3% damage per held energy on every pool skill. The cue (tier A: WZ paths of the Energy Charge affected art and Use sound) is presentation only (B6 reads it); the sim ignores it. No art: book 511 has no state node, so the HUD draws the pip fallback.
512._provenance: tier C: spec #412 B2 #414: Buccaneer is data-only until B11 flips playable; nothing offers it before then.

512._hp: tier C #346 (orchestrator ruling, spec #412 BU-20): the melee starting HP, copied from Hero's 112 row (jobs/hero.json); the balance pass owns it.
512._ap: tier C: spec #412 (BU-20): the Hero 112 row copied: STR primary, DEX secondary, keyframes Lv1 -> 4 and Lv200 -> 204 (AutoAp interpolates between them).

512._hp: tier C #346 (orchestrator ruling, spec #412 BU-20): melee HP growth per level, copied from Hero's 112 growth row; GAME_DESIGN 4.2.
